scope: Existing LaTeX workspace; source-order sidebar, density-preserving PDF preview, inert project media preview and navigation protection

automated.lint_typecheck_scripts: This JavaScript/Python repository has no dedicated lint or TypeScript-check script; syntax, build and domain tests were used

initial_parallel_node_run.test: quota fuses queued aliases for one actual key while a different key continues
initial_parallel_node_run.observed: peak [1,2], expected [2,2]; this analysis queue test is outside modified code

synthetic_checks: Unicode and empty headings, nested titles, source-order include expansion, repeated/shared files and cycle termination
Main/draft separation, unused text grouping, comments/macros/literal examples and explicit dynamic/conditional warnings
Outline budgets and source bytes unchanged
scale=8 on a 600x800-point PDF returns 4800x6400 pixels without downsampling
Nonfinite, negative, invalid-page and extreme allocation requests fail explicitly
PNG/JPEG/SVG preview, unsupported asset reason, external path/symlink refusal, SVG scripts/events/external-content rejection
An entry without its own PDF cannot retain the preceding entry's PDF
Real read tool to bridge to Python worker to HTTP preview route
Save conflict blocks file/project/entry changes, compile and close while retaining unsaved input
Late file/page/media responses cannot replace a newer choice even when transport ignores abort
DPR/zoom density, render/media failure recovery and object URL release

existing_host_observations.identity: DSH local build, existing authenticated Chrome PWA window
existing_host_observations.plugin: @mappedinfo/dsh-paper-library 0.2.3, web-profile source symlink to this repository
verified_via_supported_native_ui: Save state was loaded; automatic compile was off; manuscript content was never typed or compiled
Chapter click selected the expected subsection at the reported source line
media/formal PDF opened in the media preview, dimensions/page count/path shown, 100% to 125% zoom worked
Switching main.tex to draft.tex added proposal/working-note headings and changed preview from 7 to 11 pages
Restored main.tex, fit-width, 7-page PDF and loaded save state

owner_selected_manuscript_readonly_accep.catalog_location: Temporary isolated library, not the live catalog

limits: Navigation is lexical, not a full TeX interpreter; macros and conditional branches remain explicit limitations
Extreme full-page allocations are rejected at a documented memory boundary rather than silently downsampled; tiled rendering is not implemented
Transport races, failures and unsaved-edit protection were exercised in the deterministic shipped-panel DOM fixture, not injected into the owner's live manuscript
No private screenshots are included; live observations are recorded as text
No physical-device study, model request, push or publication
